svg.title: Engineering system map
svg.desc: Frontend: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript. API: Spring Boot, REST APIs, API design. Services: Java, Maven, Software design. Integrations: System integration, Business systems, Third-party services. Intelligence: AI agents, Intelligent workflows, Tool integrations. Requests flow from the frontend through the API and services to integrations; AI agents act on the system through the same APIs, as tool calls. Underneath, everything ships through Git and GitHub: branches, reviews and automation.
